subject: Gated onramp — order form sequencing and security cascade
body:
From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@novamed.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Peters <mike.peters@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing — MAP and security cadence

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Our procurement and security teams want a single view of the mutual action plan for the pilot so we can align internal approvals. High level asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which documents must be signed to enable the pilot (MSA, DPA, order form)?
- Security team needs a timeline for SOC2 evidence, questionnaire response, and any pen test windows.
- Procurement has a hard sprint to complete by Jun 18 to hit our fiscal quarter.

I attached a procurement calendar from our side and a short intake. Can your legal and sales ops propose a sequencing that lets us start the pilot by Jun 22 if we get to sign-off?

Attachments: procurement_calendar.csv

Claire
Lead Procurement Manager
NovaMed

----

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:03:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing — MAP and security cadence

Thanks Claire, this is helpful. I sketched a short MAP and sequencing that should let the pilot start without waiting for every procurement checkbox to close. Key assumptions:
- Minimum required to deploy pilot: signed MSA and order form with pilot scope; DPA sign-off is required before any production data, but pilot can run on synthetic/limited PII if we scope it in the order form.
- Security deliverables: we can provide SOC2 summary and evidence links within 5 business days; full questionnaire answers within 10 business days.
- If there are redlines to the order form, we can negotiate in parallel with legal; order form must be executed for billing/seat allocation.

Proposed timeline (target pilot kickoff Jun 22):
Week 1 (Jun 1–7): legal review of DPA and order form, security requests submitted
Week 2 (Jun 8–14): redline cycle and internal procurement review; SOC2 evidence shared; preliminary canary environment provisioned
Week 3 (Jun 15–21): final sign-off, DocuSign envelopes out, pilot provisioning and runbook handoff

Action items I will own:
- Share redlined order form template by EOD Jun 2 (Mina)
- Confirm SOC2 artifact links and Service Org contact (Vanessa)
- Coordinate DocuSign envelope once legal approves order form (Karthik)

I attached a short MAP draft and an example order form to start. If procurement needs firm language about data residency or indemnity we should flag now so legal can prioritize.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: NovaMed_SOW_v2.pdf

----

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 10:17:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing — legal notes and order form items

Mina/Team,

Quick legal read: we can support the pilot-in-parallel approach but two clauses will require negotiation and likely small edits to the order form:
1) Data residency and processing locations — NovaMed wants EU-only processing language in one of their internal use-cases. We need to confirm whether the pilot data will be covered by the same residency guarantees; if so, that may require a DPA addendum or a scoped clause in the order form.
2) Indemnity and limitation of liability — NovaMed proposed tightening their cap for pilot liability which is nonstandard. We can offer a compromise for the pilot window only.

Recommendation: run DPA redlines and order form edits in parallel with procurement. Provide us any non-negotiable contract asks by Jun 4 noon so we can prioritize.

Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference

----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 08:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing — procurement readiness and billing

Team,

Procurement note: NovaMed needs a signed order form to allocate spend and request a dedicated instance for the pilot. If we can get the order form in DocuSign by Jun 12 we can meet their internal commit for Jun 18. Two points:
- If they request reserved capacity there will be a longer lead time for capacity planning; confirm pilot will use hosted shared pool to speed provisioning.
- We should add a short billing schedule in the order form with a pilot discount and explicit rollback clause so procurement can approve faster.

I can prepare the DocuSign envelope once legal provides the final order form. Also cc Vanessa to confirm SOC2 artifact owner.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

----

From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@novamed.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 14:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp sequencing — procurement readiness and billing

Thanks all. Procurement confirmed they can approve a hosted pilot order (no reserved capacity) if the order form includes:
- Pilot scope and limited seats
- Financial cap and pilot discount (30%)
- Data handling notes for the pilot (limited PII and synthetic data)

I attached a redlined order form from our end and an updated procurement calendar. We marked Jun 18 as their internal approval cutoff. Can Redwood push final orderform and DocuSign by Jun 12?

Attachments: redlined_orderform_NovaMed_v3.docx, procurement_calendar.csv

Claire Johnson
Lead Procurement Manager
NovaMed

----

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@novamed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gated onramp — order form sequencing and security cascade

Team, finalizing next steps below so we have a single MAP to track: 

Summary of owners and deadlines:
- Legal to deliver final order form with pilot clauses (Laura) — due EOD Jun 9
- Sales Ops to prepare DocuSign envelope and billing schedule (Karthik) — due Jun 11
- Security to share SOC2 artifact links and questionnaire responses (Vanessa) — initial share Jun 4, full answers Jun 11
- Procurement to route and sign (Claire / Novamed) — target approval Jun 18

Links and artifacts: DocuSign envelope will be created at: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/details/ENVELOPE-9921
Drive folder with MAP and order form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovamedMAP
HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/7093

Meeting: I scheduled a 30-minute gate review for Mon Jun 8 10:00am PT to close any open redlines. Invite will be sent separately.

If any of the legal asks are non-starters for NovaMed (residency language or indemnity), flag them ASAP so we can escalate to our GC.

Thanks — Mina
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redlined_orderform_NovaMed_v3.docx, NovaMed_SOW_v2.pdf, procurement_calendar.csv
